card.label: Release
card.title: Release requested: {{tool}}
card.diffTooLarge: The texts are too large to compare.
card.personalTooLarge: This change is too large to show you in full. What you cannot see in full you cannot release; you can only reject it.
card.personal: Personal: this run read what only you see through your own access, or it is in your conversation. If you release it, exactly the content below is written, and others can read it. It is no longer marked personal after that. If the agent should no longer see what came before, choose “Start afresh” in your conversation alone with it.
card.askerDecides: The person who asked the agent decides.
card.reasonRedacted: Only the person who was asked sees a reason.
card.notYours: Only the person who asked the agent decides. Whoever may see the run sees the details.
card.externalArgs: These arguments go to the external server exactly as shown:
card.externalArgsHidden: Only the person asked sees the arguments.

outcome.approved: Released on {{when}}. The agent carries it out shortly.
outcome.stale: Released on {{when}}, but not carried out: the content changed since the request. The agent may ask again.
outcome.failed: Released on {{when}}, but not carried out: the step took too long (other work held the data) and was undone. The agent may try again.
outcome.rejected: Rejected on {{when}}. Nothing was carried out.
outcome.expired: Expired: nobody decided in time. Nothing was carried out.

question.label: Question
question.title: The agent asks
question.askerAnswers: The person who asked the agent answers.
question.redacted: Only the person who asked the agent sees the question.

page.title: Releases
page.description: What agents want to do on your behalf and do only once you release it.

waiting.question: {{name}} answers, on the card in the conversation.

approval.not_found: This release does not exist (any more), or you may not see it.
approval.not_addressed: Only the person who asked the agent decides.
approval.not_permitted: You may not (any more) do yourself what the agent wants to do, so you cannot release it either.
approval.decided: This release has been decided already.
approval.expired: This release has expired; the agent stopped waiting.
approval.run_ended: The run no longer waits for it (it finished or was cancelled).
approval.version_conflict: The release has changed meanwhile. It was reloaded.
approval.not_shown_in_full: This change cannot be shown in full, so it cannot be released.

question.not_found: This question does not exist (any more), or you may not see it.
question.not_addressed: Only the person who asked the agent answers.
question.answered: This question has been answered already.
question.expired: This question has expired; the agent stopped waiting.
question.run_ended: The run no longer waits for the answer (it finished or was cancelled).
question.version_conflict: The question has changed meanwhile. It was reloaded.
